name: Sheet music
description: Turn a melody into notation, and notation back into sound.

presets.label: Melody → sheet music (PDF)
presets.description: Detects the notes of ONE melodic line and engraves them with LilyPond. Humming, whistling or a solo instrument — a full mix will not transcribe sensibly.

presets.label: List the notes
presets.description: The detected notes with times — no engraving, useful for checking a transcription before trusting it

presets.label: Notation → piano audio
presets.description: Plays a .mid, .ly or MusicXML file as piano. A photo or scan of sheet music is optical music recognition and is not supported.
